name: Blue Hawaii Aniki's X Haven vol.2
source: "Blue Hawaii Aniki's X Haven vol.2" is a comedy visual novel parodying late-night variety shows. Hosted by the eccentric "Blue Hawaii Aniki", he guides you into a world filled with unique characters and absurd situations.
translation: 《蓝色夏威夷Aniki's X Haven vol.2》是一部模仿深夜综艺节目的喜剧视觉小说。他由古怪的“蓝色夏威夷Aniki”主持，带领你进入一个充满独特人物和荒诞情境的世界。
